headline: New Zealand Inflation Slows to 3.7% Ahead of RBNZ October Policy Decision
summary: New Zealand consumer price inflation cooled to 3.7% in the year to September despite broad price pressures, as analysts anticipate the Reserve Bank of New Zealand may raise the OCR by 25 basis points to 3%.
why: RBNZ decisions set the benchmark cost of borrowing in New Zealand and influence international carry trade dynamics.

impacts.name: NZD/USD
impacts.why: Cooling inflation reduces long-term tightening pressure, balanced against expectations of a near-term 25 bps hike.
